payload.entry:
Completed the README and plugin docs phase in bob-plugins. Replaced the README monolith with a concise front door while preserving the generated requirements region. Added the shared topic guides for Block ID defaults, BLOCKS mirrors, Task Card, Go To task URI, Open Notes URI, highlights, and Templater trigger; added flat source nav lists at docs/nav.yml and docs/develop/nav.yml; added the develop hub and architecture, validation, plugin APIs, dependency migration, and deployment guides; linked related topics from the plugin pages. Used synthetic identifiers and verified same-tree and cross-mounted links. No bob-cli files changed.

Verification: npm run validate passed (plugin build check, docs inventory, and manifests); npm run docs:inventory:check passed; custom local Markdown and mounted bob-cli link checks passed; git diff --check passed. npm test ran 3206 tests: 3199 passed and 7 failed. On a clean archive of base 7e749018b39a96d9d1a8972a74144cc27034fe48, the same six non-timing failures reproduced: four unblocked-glyph cases (already tracked by bob-cli-6v), Keep counts once (bob-cli-6w), and reverse project conversion BLOCKS link (bob-cli-7i). The stage-entry performance budget case failed once at 17.87ms against 16ms on the changed tree and passed on clean base at 16.755ms. A synthetic vault passed migration dry-run without edits and --write adoption of a dependency field into the canonical Depends-On line. Isolated bob plugins sync copied all managed files; required sync to /home/bryan/bob completed with 0 copied, 0 skipped, and 19 unchanged. URI activation remains a manual GUI check.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Investigate the intermittent dependency stage-entry performance budget miss (17.87ms against 16ms); it passed on the clean base at 16.755ms, and no matching bead was found.

README and topic/develop docs are complete; npm run validate and docs inventory passed; links, migration rehearsal, isolated sync, and required bob plugins sync were checked. Full suite has six known clean-base failures tracked by bob-cli-6v, bob-cli-6w, bob-cli-7i, plus one stage-entry timing miss recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Epic symbols: none.

payload.entry: LAND TRIAGE (bob-cli-a0.10.1.land): PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs from .2#1, .3#2, .4#1, .5#2 all describe pre-existing bob-plugins npm test failures not caused by this docs-only epic; each is an existing READY task, corroborated once with +1: bob-cli-6v (unblocked-glyph x4), bob-cli-6w (Keep counts once), bob-cli-7i (project conversion BLOCKS ^prj link), bob-cli-3w (stage-ranker 16ms budget; .4's 'stage-entry 17.87ms, no matching bead' is the same test stage-ranker-filters-1000-synthetic-tasks-under-16-ms-per-keystroke, so no new task). .5#1 limitation 'live urls.txt not published yet' belongs to active epic bob-cli-a0.5.1 (first publish in a0.5.1.5) and was declined as a follow-up. .5#1 limitation 'publish workflow has no setup-node' is caused by this epic (bob-docs check --production now runs the Node inventory generator) and is folded into the remaining-work tale. Discovered while landing: docs-publish.yml/docs-weekly.yml jobs lack runs-on — caused by active epic bob-cli-a0.5.1, recorded there as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note, no task created.

Verified completion of the generated Obsidian plugin reference epic. All five child phases are closed: source-owned mounted hubs preserve authored pages and guardrails; the static inventory generates facts and 76 registered commands for seven plugins; all seven reference pages are complete; README topics were migrated into a concise front door and topic/developer pages while preserving the remaining detail; and both plugin doc trees are mounted and verified end to end.

The land review found that the new compatibility-page link to `reference/plugins/index.md` was missing from the isolated Zensical test fixture. Added the mounted-page stub to that fixture. The initial `just docs-check` then passed on rerun: lint, generated drift, strict Zensical, 97 published URLs, offline lychee, all 80 search cases (including `install plugins` -> `/reference/plugins/#install` and `Yank absolute path with tilde` -> `/reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/#registered-commands`), tutorial, media determinism, and all 406 documentation tests. Also verified `just docs-gen`, `just docs-build-material`, plugin `npm run validate`, scanner/wrapper tests, focused publish-workflow tests, and `bob plugins sync --repo <opened bob-plugins checkout> --no-pull` passed. `git diff --check` is clean in bob-cli, bob-plugins, and plans. Current source SHAs: bob-cli `50d0e990`; bob-plugins `2af765d`.

Full plugin `npm test` remains 3199/3206 with seven failures already reproduced on clean base and triaged on this epic: four unblocked-glyph cases (`bob-cli-6v`), Keep counts once (`bob-cli-6w`), reverse project conversion retaining a BLOCKS ^prj link (`bob-cli-7i`), and the stage-ranker 16 ms timing flake (`bob-cli-3w`). LAND TRIAGE also recorded that the unpublished live `urls.txt` belongs to active epic `bob-cli-a0.5.1`; missing `setup-node` in publish workflows is folded into that epic's remaining work; and docs-publish/docs-weekly `runs-on` issues are recorded there as a discovered issue, with no task bead. The already-ready tasks were corroborated; no new task beads were created.

The approved plan `202610/plugin_reference.md` is now marked `status: done`. `just symvision` was attempted but this Justfile has no such recipe, and `just --list` showed no symvision/vision equivalent.
